# TradingSocial

> The social trading journal for serious traders. Journal trades, track real performance, follow other traders and compete on leaderboards that label every record's source.

TradingSocial is an education and performance-tracking platform. It does not provide financial advice. All prices are in Australian dollars (AUD).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.tradingsocial.io/): The social trading journal for serious traders: public trading profiles, a trading journal, leaderboards and a trader newsfeed.
- [Pricing](https://www.tradingsocial.io/pricing): Free forever, Trader at A$30/month, Pro Trader at A$50/month. Every new account gets 14 days of Pro Trader free; a card is required to start it.

## Solutions

- [Trading journals by trader](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for): Targeted trading journal and performance tracking for forex, crypto, futures and MT5 traders, prop-firm challengers and trading educators.
- [Trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/journal): The online trading journal that gives feedback, not just storage: log every trade, get a weekly review, and see insights with their sample size stated.
- [Forex trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/forex): Track pips and R multiples on every forex trade, compare performance across London, New York, Asia and Sydney sessions, and log spread and swap costs.
- [Crypto trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/crypto): A crypto trading journal for a market that never sleeps. Log spot and perpetual trades, tag FOMO and revenge trades, and track risk in R, not dollars.
- [Futures trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/futures): A futures trading journal for YM, RTY, micros (MES, MNQ) and commodities (CL, GC). Track contract size, tick value and R multiples, scored for consistency.
- [MT5 trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/mt5): Import your MT5 statement or connect your account on the Pro plan — closed trades sync hourly, verified and locked so imported prices and results can't be edited.
- [Prop firm trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/prop-firm): A prop firm trading journal for evaluation and funded accounts: cap risk per trade, set the rules that keep you off the drawdown line, and sync MT5.
- [For trading educators](https://www.tradingsocial.io/for/educators): A trading educator platform where your broker-verified track record, public profile and follower base do the talking, not screenshots.

- [Trading journal vs spreadsheet](https://www.tradingsocial.io/compare/vs-trading-journal-spreadsheet): An honest comparison of a trading journal spreadsheet against a dedicated journal: what Excel genuinely does better, where it quietly costs you, and how to decide.
- [Best prop firm trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/compare/best-prop-firm-trading-journal): Seven things a prop firm trading journal has to do, why each one matters during an evaluation, and where TradingSocial meets them and where it doesn't.
- [Best MT5 trading journal](https://www.tradingsocial.io/compare/best-mt5-trading-journal): Sync or statement import? What MetaTrader 5 actually exposes, the six questions worth asking before you pick an MT5 trading journal, and where TradingSocial lands.
